sql_templates.description: Select VCP candidates with the latest prices and strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT eq.symbol, eq.close, eq.volume, snap.stage, snap.enhanced_fund_score, vcp.vcp_score
FROM market.equity_eod eq
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots snap ON eq.symbol = snap.symbol
JOIN scores.stage2_vcp_picks vcp ON eq.symbol = vcp.symbol
WHERE eq.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
AND snap.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND vcp.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
AND snap.stage = 'STAGE_2'
AND snap.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY vcp.vcp_score DESC
LIMIT 20;
